as_of_content:
[[File:The Matrix of Leadership portrait.png|thumb|256x256px]]'''The Matrix of Leadership''' is an iconic Relic that has been around since the Beta stage, but has only recently been made available.

==Description==
''A sturdy case locks a crystal of immense power safely inside. It is said that in times of despair, the Matrix will light our darkest hour.''
==Relic Boosts==
*+15% XP in Story and Special Missions
==Obtainment==
This anniversary Relic was given to all Commanders who joined the game before v1.1 (May 2017). 
==Gallery==
<gallery>
Matrix of Leadership Beta.jpg|Beta portrait
The Matrix of Leadership icon.jpg
</gallery>

==Notes==
